import hashlib, io, json, math
from collections import deque
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result
from src.envs.pair_table_export import point_id, state_id, ViewState

NAME = 'diag_e2e_look_non_anchor_01'
ROOT = Path.cwd().resolve()
source, source_ref = audited_result(ROOT / 'results/smoke_e2e_look_views_01_retry2.json')
assert source['_meta']['exit_code'] == 1 and source['metrics']['black_frame_detected'] is False
assert source['metrics']['cleanup_errors'] == []
failed = source['metrics']['exports'][0]
assert failed['error'] == {'message': 'non_anchor_divergent', 'type': 'ValueError'}
raw = (Path(failed['scratch_directory']) / 'raw').resolve()
used = []

def checked(ref, inside=None):
    path = Path(ref['file']).resolve()
    if inside is not None:
        assert path.is_relative_to(inside), path
    body = path.read_bytes()
    assert len(body) == ref['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest() == ref['sha256'], path
    if ref not in used: used.append(ref)
    return body

index = json.loads(checked(failed['raw_index'], raw))
refs = {Path(ref['file']).resolve(): ref for ref in index['files']}
assert len(refs) == len(index['files'])
package = json.loads(checked(failed['source_package']))
anchor, candidates = package['anchor_name'], package['candidate_names']
actions = []
for path, ref in refs.items():
    if path.name.startswith('action_') and path.suffix == '.json':
        actions.append((ref, json.loads(checked(ref, raw))))
actions.sort(key=lambda item: item[1]['index'])
last = actions[-4:]
assert [item[1]['action'] for item in last] == ['Pass', 'SetObjectPoses', 'PhysicsSyncTransforms', 'Pass']
assert all(item[1]['exception'] is None and item[1]['after_metadata']['lastActionSuccess'] for item in last)
world_records = [last[0][1], last[3][1]]
teleport = next(item for item in reversed(actions[:-3]) if item[1]['action'] == 'TeleportFull')
arguments = teleport[1]['arguments']
heading = int(round(arguments['rotation']['y'] / 45)) % 8
view = ViewState(point_id(arguments['position']), heading)

frames, metadata, masks, structural, frame_refs = [], [], [], [], []
for action in world_records:
    capture = action['capture']
    files = capture['files']
    for ref in files.values():
        assert refs[Path(ref['file']).resolve()] == ref
    meta = json.loads(checked(files['metadata'], raw))
    assert meta == action['after_metadata']
    frame = np.array(Image.open(io.BytesIO(checked(files['rgb'], raw))))
    assert frame.shape == (255, 255, 3) and frame.dtype == np.uint8
    assert hashlib.sha256(frame.tobytes()).hexdigest() == capture['rgb_sha256']
    with np.load(io.BytesIO(checked(files['masks'], raw)), allow_pickle=False) as pack:
        named = {str(name): mask.copy().astype(bool) for name, mask in zip(pack['names'], pack['masks'])}
        other = {str(name): mask.copy().astype(bool) for name, mask in zip(pack['structural_ids'], pack['structural_masks'])}
    assert all(value.shape == (255, 255) for value in [*named.values(), *other.values()])
    frames.append(frame); metadata.append(meta); masks.append(named); structural.append(other); frame_refs.append(files)

delta = np.abs(frames[0].astype(np.int16) - frames[1].astype(np.int16))
maximum = delta.max(axis=2)
empty = np.zeros((255, 255), dtype=bool)
anchor_pixels = [int(world.get(anchor, empty).sum()) for world in masks]
assert anchor_pixels == [0, 0] and maximum.max() > 3
assert metadata[0]['agent'] == metadata[1]['agent']
camera_fields = ('cameraPosition', 'fov', 'screenWidth', 'screenHeight')
assert all(metadata[0].get(key) == metadata[1].get(key) for key in camera_fields)

def box(mask):
    yy, xx = np.nonzero(mask)
    return None if not len(xx) else [int(xx.min()), int(yy.min()), int(xx.max()), int(yy.max())]

pixel_stats = {}
for threshold in (0, 3, 10):
    changed = maximum > threshold
    pixel_stats[str(threshold)] = {'pixels': int(changed.sum()), 'channels': int((delta > threshold).sum()),
        'inclusive_xy_bbox': box(changed), 'row_counts': [int(v) for v in changed.sum(axis=1)],
        'column_counts': [int(v) for v in changed.sum(axis=0)]}

objects = [{row['name']: row for row in meta['objects']} for meta in metadata]
assert set(objects[0]) == set(objects[1])
pose_differences, state_differences = [], []
state_fields = ('openness', 'isOpen', 'isToggled', 'isBroken', 'isFilledWithLiquid', 'isCooked',
                'isSliced', 'isPickedUp', 'temperature', 'axisAlignedBoundingBox', 'objectOrientedBoundingBox')
for name in sorted(objects[0]):
    if name == anchor: continue
    a, b = objects[0][name], objects[1][name]
    if a['position'] != b['position'] or a['rotation'] != b['rotation']:
        pose_differences.append({'name': name, 'object_type': a['objectType'],
            'w0_position': a['position'], 'w1_position': b['position'],
            'w0_rotation': a['rotation'], 'w1_rotation': b['rotation'],
            'position_delta_m': {axis: b['position'][axis] - a['position'][axis] for axis in ('x','y','z')},
            'rotation_delta_degrees': {axis: b['rotation'][axis] - a['rotation'][axis] for axis in ('x','y','z')}})
    changed_fields = {key: [a.get(key), b.get(key)] for key in state_fields if a.get(key) != b.get(key)}
    if changed_fields: state_differences.append({'name': name, 'fields': changed_fields})

overlaps = []
union_all = empty.copy()
for name in sorted(set(masks[0]) | set(masks[1])):
    union = masks[0].get(name, empty) | masks[1].get(name, empty)
    union_all |= union
    counts = {str(threshold): int((union & (maximum > threshold)).sum()) for threshold in (0,3,10)}
    if counts['0']:
        eroded = union.copy()
        eroded[1:] &= union[:-1]; eroded[:-1] &= union[1:]
        eroded[:,1:] &= union[:,:-1]; eroded[:,:-1] &= union[:,1:]
        edge = union & ~eroded
        overlaps.append({'name': name, 'object_type': objects[0].get(name, {}).get('objectType'),
            'mask_union_pixels': int(union.sum()), 'difference_overlap_pixels': counts,
            'difference_bbox': box(union & (maximum > 3)),
            'edge_overlap_gt3': int((edge & (maximum > 3)).sum()),
            'interior_overlap_gt3': int((eroded & (maximum > 3)).sum()),
            'mask_equal': bool(np.array_equal(masks[0].get(name, empty), masks[1].get(name, empty)))})
overlaps.sort(key=lambda item: (-item['difference_overlap_pixels']['3'], item['name']))
structural_overlaps = []
for name in sorted(set(structural[0]) | set(structural[1])):
    union = structural[0].get(name, empty) | structural[1].get(name, empty)
    count = int((union & (maximum > 3)).sum())
    if count: structural_overlaps.append({'id': name, 'pixels_gt3': count, 'difference_bbox': box(union & (maximum > 3))})

remaining = maximum > 3
components = []
remaining = remaining.copy()
for y, x in zip(*np.nonzero(remaining)):
    if not remaining[y, x]: continue
    queue = deque([(int(y),int(x))]); remaining[y, x] = False; coords = []
    while queue:
        py, px = queue.popleft(); coords.append((py, px))
        for ny, nx in ((py-1,px),(py+1,px),(py,px-1),(py,px+1)):
            if 0 <= ny < 255 and 0 <= nx < 255 and remaining[ny,nx]:
                remaining[ny,nx] = False; queue.append((ny,nx))
    ys, xs = zip(*coords)
    components.append({'pixels': len(coords), 'inclusive_xy_bbox': [min(xs),min(ys),max(xs),max(ys)],
                       'max_channel_difference': int(maximum[list(ys),list(xs)].max())})
components.sort(key=lambda item: (-item['pixels'], item['inclusive_xy_bbox']))

out = ROOT / 'logs/runs' / NAME
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
figure_dir = ROOT / 'logs/review' / NAME
figure_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(12, 4), constrained_layout=True)
for world in (0,1):
    axes[world].imshow(frames[world]); axes[world].set_title('Original w' + str(world))
    axes[world].set_xlabel('x pixel'); axes[world].set_ylabel('y pixel')
im = axes[2].imshow(maximum, cmap='inferno', vmin=0, vmax=int(maximum.max()))
axes[2].set_title('Max channel absolute difference'); axes[2].set_xlabel('x pixel')
fig.colorbar(im, ax=axes[2], shrink=.8)
for ax in axes:
    bounds = pixel_stats['3']['inclusive_xy_bbox']
    if bounds:
        from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
        x0,y0,x1,y1 = bounds
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x0-.5,y0-.5),x1-x0+1,y1-y0+1,fill=False,color='cyan',linewidth=1))
fig.suptitle(f"{failed['pair_id']} | {state_id(view)} | cyan: difference > 3 bounds")
figure_path = figure_dir / 'original_frames_and_difference.png'
fig.savefig(figure_path, dpi=160); plt.close(fig)
figure_bytes = figure_path.read_bytes()
summary = {'diagnostic_only': True, 'source': source_ref, 'pair_id': failed['pair_id'],
    'raw_index': failed['raw_index'], 'authenticated_source_package': failed['source_package'],
    'failed_view_state_id': state_id(view), 'heading_index': heading,
    'last_TeleportFull': {'reference': teleport[0], 'arguments': arguments},
    'paired_action_sequence': [{'reference': ref, 'action': item['action'], 'index': item['index']} for ref,item in last],
    'frame_references_w0_w1': frame_refs, 'anchor_name': anchor, 'candidate_names': candidates,
    'anchor_pixels_w0_w1': anchor_pixels, 'camera_identical': True,
    'agent': metadata[0]['agent'], 'camera': {key: metadata[0].get(key) for key in camera_fields},
    'anchor_world_objects': [world[anchor] for world in objects],
    'pixel_counts_by_strict_threshold': pixel_stats, 'max_channel_abs_difference': int(delta.max()),
    'per_pixel_max_difference_histogram': [{'difference': int(value), 'pixels': int((maximum == value).sum())}
        for value in np.unique(maximum)],
    'non_anchor_object_count': len(objects[0])-1, 'non_anchor_pose_exactly_identical': not pose_differences,
    'non_anchor_pose_differences': pose_differences, 'non_anchor_state_field_differences': state_differences,
    'object_mask_overlaps': overlaps, 'structural_mask_overlaps': structural_overlaps,
    'unassigned_pixels_gt3': int(((maximum > 3) & ~union_all).sum()),
    'connected_components_gt3': components,
    'interpretation_limit': 'Masks identify receiving surfaces, not the causal light/shadow/reflection source. No rerender or new scientific threshold.',
    'E2E_stop_rule': 'tasks/E2E.md: each step failure stops; original fixed five-pair exporter rejects subset filtering',
    'figure': {'file': str(figure_path.relative_to(ROOT)), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(figure_bytes).hexdigest(), 'bytes': len(figure_bytes)},
    'authenticated_raw_references': used}
summary_path = out / 'diagnostic.json'
with summary_path.open('x') as stream: json.dump(summary, stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False); stream.write('\n')
compact = {key:value for key,value in summary.items() if key not in ('authenticated_raw_references','anchor_world_objects')}
for value in compact['pixel_counts_by_strict_threshold'].values():
    value.pop('row_counts'); value.pop('column_counts')
print('DIAGNOSTIC_JSON: ' + json.dumps(compact, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False), flush=True)
config.scope: environment setup or diagnostic, not a research result
